description:
## 1.0.0 (2026-11-23)

### ✨ New Features

* AMOLED dark theme for Amazon Shopping ([d8733ee](https://github.com/Axandel/amazon-amoled-patches/commit/d8733ee707294091d2c6077ad7bc5c0e324d708d))

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Pure black dark theme for the whole app: web pages (products, search, cart...) and native screens. Product photos and the buy buttons keep their real colors. Do not combine with another "Dark mode" patch.

options.description: "Always on" makes the app dark even when the phone is in light mode.
Product photos have white backgrounds. Dimming them is easier on the eyes at night. Allowed values: 30 to 100.
"Accurate colors" keeps product photos and buttons exactly as they are. "Fast" uses a cheaper filter that slightly fades saturated colors. Pick it only if scrolling stutters.
Also repaint the screens that are not web pages (menus, top bar, bottom bar, settings) in pure black.
